patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Microsoft Teams and SaneBox share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Microsoft Teams only if your buying job matches “M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on ” rather than SaneBox's shape. Choose SaneBox only if your buying job matches “SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outloo” rather than Microsoft Teams's shape. Workflow advantage differs because Microsoft Teams is shaped for M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Pho whereas SaneBox is shaped for SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mai. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Microsoft Teams and SaneBox share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Microsoft Teams is M365 collaboration hub (chat, meetings, files) with optional Teams Phone telephony add-on — free Teams tier exists; Phone Standard ~$10/user; SaneBox is SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gmail, Outlook, Yahoo, iCloud or any IMAP account — and triages.
- Company-size focus: Microsoft Teams (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs SaneBox (solo, micro, small-business).
- Researched limits: Microsoft Teams — Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; SaneBox — Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat.

Limitations — Microsoft Teams: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job; Teams Phone requires an eligible Teams/M365 licence plus PSTN (PAYG or Calling Plan); SaneBox: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat; Billing is per person with no team or family plan, so multi-user rollouts multiply cost.

Poor-fit cases: Microsoft Teams is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Scored as a collaboration hub — Teams Phone is a telephony add-on, not the primary scored job · SaneBox is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a communication channel — SaneBox triages an existing mailbox and adds no voice, SMS, WhatsApp or chat · Avoid Microsoft Teams if you actually need SaneBox's motion (SaneBox is inbox-productivity tooling that layers onto an existing mailbox — Gma)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
